collection.title: Mercedes-Benz EQT 2023 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mercedes-Benz EQT 2023 Onwards model which requires a 26" wiper blade the drivers side and an 18" for the passengers side. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
